messages:
dan_platform: Heads up — starting coordinated deploy now for API v3.0.0, runtime v2.3.1, router v1.9. Change window 18:00-18:30 UTC. Need runtime pinned on dedicated nodes until we validate. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.0.0 

maya_prod: Confirmed window. I'll keep the console rollout behind feature flag `console_show_new_routes` until router is stable.

benj: Router change includes header rewrite for legacy clients. Recommend canary at 5% for 15m, then 25% if green.

carla-ml: Runtime v2.3.1 has the KV cache fix — perf looks good on bench. Note: model-a quant path changed; recommend pin `model-a@1.4` for now until runtime 2.3.2.

dan_platform: Ack. I'll pin model versions in deployment config. Can we add a safety rollback playbook? @deploy-bot prepare rollback steps.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary rollout: API v3.0.0 -> 5% (hosts api-canary-1..2). runtime pool `dedicated-gpu-pool` -> v2.3.1 on 2 nodes. router -> v1.9 canary 5%.

benj: quick heads-up — logs from api-canary-1 show 500s on `/v1/chat` after ~3m, stack trace includes `runtime:kv-cache::nullptr`. tagging @carla-ml.

carla-ml: Looking. Could be memory alignment mismatch with older CUDA drivers. Which cuda on the canary hosts?

dan_platform: api-canary-1: cuda 11.4, api-canary-2: cuda 11.7.

carla-ml: That's it. Runtime v2.3.1 requires CUDA >= 11.6 for the new allocation path. Recommend immediate rollback on nodes with 11.4 or pin routing to runtime v2.3.0 for that subset.

maya_prod: We can pin routing policy: `route.policy.runtime = version_pin('2.3.0') for cluster=us-east-1-ca` — I'll patch the policy if you confirm.

dan_platform: Do it. Also @deploy-bot roll back runtime on api-canary-1. We'll continue canary in regions with CUDA>=11.6.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling back runtime on api-canary-1 -> v2.3.0. Canary API traffic routed 3/5 hosts now. Notifying oncall.

alex_oncall: Taking over smoke checks. Running: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api-canary-1.internal/v1/health`

benj: smoke returned 200. No 500s in the last 2m. Looks stable after rollback. Proceed with extended canary only in regions that meet CUDA>=11.6.

dan_platform: Decision summary: abort router v1.9 global canary; hold router rollout until node images are updated. Proceed with API v3.0.0 canary in validated regions. I'll update the release notes with this decision: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.0.0/notes

maya_prod: :thumbsup: I'll toggle the console FF off globally until router/runtime are sorted.

dan_platform: Postmortem actions assigned: 1) Add driver-version check to deploy gating (owner: carla-ml), 2) Add runtime->CUDA compatibility matrix to release notes (owner: benj), 3) Patch deploy-bot to auto-pin runtime per-host (owner: maya_prod).

carla-ml: I'll PR the matrix and add a small infra smoketest script. ETA ~4h.

benj: I'll open a node image update PR to bump CUDA to 11.7 for the us-east-1 canary fleet.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: finished rollback on api-canary-1 at 1802506998.
